headline: GIFT Nifty signals strong rebound as Indian stock market reopens following holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty indicates a strong market rebound, with analysts viewing 26,000 as a major resistance hurdle.
Markets recently experienced a sharp sell-off, with the Sensex falling 1,484 points due to heavy profit-taking in banking and metal stocks.
FIIs sustained their 16-session buying streak, purchasing equities worth ₹5,672.99 crore despite market pullbacks.
Reports of proposed US tariff hikes on India and 15 other nations present potential global trade headwinds.
whatHappening: SpiceJet operational fleet has reduced to six aircraft, forcing daily flights down to 20.
FIIs continued their net buying streak by adding ₹5,672.99 crore into the Indian equity market.
BSE and NSE were closed on November 24 on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti.
Investor wealth expanded by ₹34.61 trillion over November amid strong broader market gains.
summary: Indian share markets reopen today with GIFT Nifty pointing to a potential rebound towards the 26,000 mark. The benchmark indices had previously seen a sharp drop led by selling in banking and metal shares prior to the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday. Meanwhile, foreign institutional investors continue to support the market, maintaining a 16-session buying streak.
